- **Diff from my read-only pre-review of 4090ffcb:**
  - Only `import_proof_contract.py` changes, plus the README.
  - The changes are AUDIT_REVIEW_ID=6125341751, CANDIDATE_HEAD and MERGED_TREE bound to the actual merge, and EXPECTED_PROOF_ROOT bound to the exact timestamped root.
  - I verified the merge parents and tree locally with git.
- **First-root binding:**
  - `require_first_proof_root` runs before any copy or CLI in `rehearse_import.py` (`main`, right after `bound_candidate`) and in `export_launch_import_proof.py`.
  - It runs again in `validate_proof` and the freeze path.
  - I checked locally that it accepts the bound root and refuses the failed 10:52Z root and a one-second-off sibling.
- **Timing:** `measured_timing_headroom` needs each measured stage (dry, apply, repeat, jobs-OFF readiness and jobs-ON readiness) to be at most 540 s. It also needs at least 600 s left of 5400 s after the stages and 660 s of observation, and the frozen manifest must equal the proof value.
  - The prior readiness of about 103 s is historical only; the new proof must measure it.
  - A margin refusal burns this root, so another forward source would be needed.
- **Guards:** I ran the committed `run_import_guards.py` payload locally (local `python3` instead of the ssh hop) against 630b2354. Result: 175/175 OK, 0 failures/errors/skips, completed 13:44:27 UTC, no production access.
- **Self-check:** this body passes the 630b2354 `source_review_pass` token check with the actual file hashes.

- The production binding stays UNREVIEWED_NATIVE_FORWARD_REFUSE/0 until a NEW production-source review.
